items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They had one cat that was really on Bird. He was one of the main ones playing up there one night when I was playing with Bird.

ctx.x: No, no. I think he said that he got shot stealing a t.v. out of a church, but I don’t know if he was talking about Nicky Hill or that guy.
